fields.summary_ko.0: TSM surged 33.2% over the past year, far exceeding 6.8% broad semiconductor sector growth, benefiting from accelerated AI investment and increased demand for advanced semiconductor technology
fields.summary_ko.1: TSM Q3 2026 revenue reached $4.672 billion, up 41.2% year-over-year, net income increased 68.7%, with advanced technology (7nm and below) accounting for 79% of wafer revenue
